analysis.purpose: CliVcsAdapter.currentHead is an adapter method that returns the current HEAD commit reference for a repository by delegating to a standalone `currentHead` utility. It implements the VCS adapter's contract for discovering the current revision.
responsibilities: Expose a VCS method to read the current HEAD of a repository
Delegate to the underlying currentHead implementation

outputs.name: headRef
outputs.description: Current HEAD reference (sha, branch name, or tag)

sideEffects: May read git metadata via the delegated utility
errorBehavior: Does not handle errors here; any failure from the delegated utility propagates
invariants: Return value is exactly what the delegated currentHead utility returns
preconditions: The delegated `currentHead` function must be importable and callable
The repository at `root` must be a valid git workspace if the utility depends on git
postconditions: Returns a string identifying the current HEAD
risks: Behavior and failure modes depend on the unresolved callee
whatToDistrust: The delegated `currentHead` call is unresolved; its exact semantics and error handling are not in the seed

nodes.name: VCS current HEAD query
nodes.summary: Read the current HEAD reference of a repository

edges.rationale: The adapter method exposes the current-HEAD capability by delegating to the concrete utility
